stem.text: The structure of disodium cromoglycate is shown.

stem.alt: Structure of disodium cromoglycate, labelled in the drawing. Two chromone (4-oxobenzopyran) ring systems, each with a CO2Na group on the ring carbon next to the ring oxygen, are joined by an OCH2–CH(OH)–CH2O chain attached at C5 of each ring.
